rachel: Dropping a micro one-pager draft for review: SLAs + 1-line deploy decider + 3-bullet bench snapshot. Link: https://drive.redwood/onepagers/inference-slas-pocket

tom: I skimmed. Can the SLA table be 3 rows (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with just P99 (seq<=512) and uptime SLO? Field needs a scannable table for calls.

nina: Agreed. Also add a single-row fallback visual: Hosted ➜ Dedicated ➜ Private with short note on when routing triggers (capacity spike / security flag).

chris: For inbound routing: keep rules minimal. Proposed tags: industry, deploy_interest, urgency. Example rule in doc: fintech + private + rfp => route: solutions-enterprise; tag: ciso.
rachel: added that, plus a quick recommended AE SLA: respond to pilot leads within 24h. Also included three outbound subject lines tailored to audiences.

tom: Bench bullets look good. Suggest rounding for field share: median ~40ms, p99 ~180-220ms on Hosted baseline; cost ballpark ~$0.05-0.08 /k tokens depending on quant/batching. Add note: numbers vary by sequence length and KV cache hit rate.
nina: Webinar plan in doc: 20m bench narrative (runtime eng), 15m deploy playbook (solutions SE), 15m Q&A. Include two 90s demos: failover routing & cost dashboard.

chris: Demo script draft: "Send burst -> observe autoscaler delta -> routing falls back to Dedicated -> show that Private traffic is pinned and not moved." Keep it tight. I'll refine into 6 lines.
design-bot: task created: onepager_micro_v1 -> visual export. ETA: EOD. Will produce PNG for slide and small 1:1 graphic for webinar.

lead-router-bot: routing-sim: sample rule check OK for 12 test leads. Outputs: 3 -> solutions-enterprise, 7 -> growth, 2 -> dedicated-ops.
rachel: Nice. Final asks: people comment on Drive doc by 3pm PT. If all good, we'll export assets, schedule the webinar, and seed invites to 30 prioritized inbound leads. :rocket:
